exposure: labor induction using an intracervical Foley catheter
outcome: success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
cohort: 68 pregnant women with a history of a previous Caesarean section who underwent labor induction via Foley catheter
finding: The use of a Foley catheter for labor induction in women with a previous cesarean delivery is a safe option with a good success rate and few maternal and fetal complications.
